newsitem.title: UK: Mitsui O.S.K.links with Thai shipping firm.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui O.S.K.links with Thai shipping firm.

text.p: Japanese shipping group Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd said Tuesday it has agreed to form a Bangkok joint venture with a Thai shipping firm to ship cement, plaster and other freight.
Mitsui O.S.K. will hold 49 percent of the new company while partner Regional Container Lines Public Co will take a 51 percent stake.
Thai demand for dry bulk cargo is expected to soar, and Mitsui O.S.K. plans to make the venture its base in Southeast Asia, the company said.
The firm, which will be set up in in July and capitalized at 100 million baht, will own vessels and handle related business.
Mitsui O.S.K. already participates in a joint venture with a Vietnamese partner. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
